f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$f" ] && echo "$f" | grep -qE 'ai-harness\.ts|packages/ai-skills/src/'; then jq -n --arg msg "Docs out-of-sync: $f was modified. '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":$msg}}'; fi 2>/dev/null || true
